messages:
zoe_cs: FYI — import job from yesterday bumped a chunk of trial accounts to 'active' and lifted healthscore. audit shows enrichment added `synthetic_event` flags. could skew renewal prioritization. anyone seen this? :thinking:

max_platform: saw it. enrichment marks inferred events as `synthetic_event=true` when confidence < 0.75. our scorer currently treats any event > 0 as fresh recency.

zoe_cs: proposal: add a "probation:enrich" tag for imported/low-confidence accounts and suppress outbound playbook triggers for 10 days. route ARR >= 100k to manual review instead of auto-suppress.

max_platform: agree. sample rule config (staging): `preconditions: source in [csv, salesforce] && enrichment_confidence < 0.75 && synthetic_event = true` -> actions: tag probation, suppress_outbound_days=10, route_high_arr=manual_review_queue.

tia_data: dry-run results for cohort import-2026-06-12: cohort_size=420 -> would_probation=320 (76%) -> would_suppress=320. ARR split: low:<10k=300, mid:10k-100k=15, high:>100k=5.

zoe_cs: that's helpful — noise is mostly low-ARR. please add a daily sample of suppressed templates (n=15) and a Slack alert when probation rate > 50% so CS/AE teams aren't surprised.

ops-bot: alert created: cs.playbook.probation.rate >= 50% -> notify #customer-success and cs-ops-email.

max_platform: rule pushed to staging for dry-run. logs will include import_job_id and enrichment_confidence. starting dry-run at 17:00 PT; will report results.

zoe_cs: thanks team — i'll notify enablement and ask AEs to monitor the manual review queue. :thumbsup:
